findings.title: Error state undefined
findings.description: Ticket does not specify workflow behavior when the user list fails to load.
findings.suggested_fix: Define an inline error state with retry, per user decision.

findings.title: Permission behavior undefined
findings.description: Ticket implies admin-only access but does not define non-admin behavior.
findings.suggested_fix: Show a 403-style message for non-admins, per user decision.

findings.title: Sortable column announcement
findings.description: Sortable table columns should reflect sort state to assistive tech.
findings.suggested_fix: Use aria-sort on column headers, now implemented in the Table extension.

findings.title: No Table component exists
findings.description: Baseline has no Table component; this ticket needs one to render the user list.
findings.suggested_fix: Add Table as a reusable design-system extension.

findings.title: Ad hoc StatusPill duplicates Badge; untraced
findings.description: A new StatusPill component was invented for the status column instead of reusing the approved Badge component. No baseline entry, extension, or exception covers it.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace StatusPill with Badge (success/warning/neutral variants already match active/invited/disabled).

findings.title: Hand-rolled error banner duplicates Table error/retry
findings.description: A custom error div and retry button were written instead of using Table's approved error/onRetry props, which already implement this exact pattern and were specifically approved for this ticket.
findings.suggested_fix: Pass error and onRetry into Table instead of rendering a separate block.

findings.title: Hardcoded hex colors instead of design tokens
findings.description: StatusPill and the error banner use raw hex values instead of the success/warning/text-secondary/danger-surface color tokens.
findings.suggested_fix: Use the established semantic color tokens.

findings.title: Error banner not announced to assistive tech
findings.description: The hand-rolled error div has no role=alert or live region, unlike Table's built-in error state. Screen reader users get no indication the load failed.
findings.suggested_fix: Use Table's error/onRetry props instead of a custom div.

findings.title: Status color contrast likely fails WCAG 2.2 AA
findings.description: StatusPill hardcodes the 600-step of success/warning instead of the semantic text tokens, which were deliberately pinned to the 700-step during the Color layer because 600 does not reliably pass 4.5:1 on white.
findings.suggested_fix: Use Badge, which already uses the correct semantic tokens.

findings.title: Empty state acceptance criterion not implemented
findings.description: The ticket explicitly requires an empty state, but MOCK_USERS is a fixed non-empty array with no code path that ever renders zero rows.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a scenario that reaches Table's existing emptyMessage state, the same way the load-error toggle already exercises the error state.

findings.title: StatusPill visually inconsistent with Badge across the app
findings.description: Every other status/label rendering in the library uses the pill-shaped Badge; this page's dot+text style breaks visual consistency even though it conveys the same information.

findings.title: Role switch not announced
findings.description: Switching the View-as role fully replaces page content (table vs 403 message) without moving focus or announcing the change.
findings.suggested_fix: Consider moving focus to the new heading or an aria-live region on role change.

findings.title: Demo/dev-only controls shipped in production component
findings.description: View-as and Simulate-load-error controls are fixture/test scaffolding mixed directly into the shipped page component, not gated behind any dev-only flag.
findings.suggested_fix: Move to Storybook/the design-system library or gate behind an environment check before merging.

findings.title: DevControls uses inline styles instead of CSS Modules
findings.description: DevControls hardcodes inline style objects for layout instead of following the CSS Modules convention used by every approved design-system component.
findings.suggested_fix: Move DevControls layout into a CSS Modules stylesheet consistent with the rest of the design system.

override.reasons: DevControls is temporary QA-only scaffolding that will be deleted before this feature ships to production (tracked in a follow-up ticket); not worth converting to CSS Modules now.

approved_decisions: Error state: inline role=alert banner with a Retry button (Table component's error/onRetry props).
Permission handling: non-admins see a 403-style message rather than the table.
Table approved as a shared design-system extension (not a ticket-scoped exception) given likely reuse across future list screens.
